title: Conveyor Belt
author: Sotehr
rules:
RULES

Sudoku

• Normal Sudoku rules apply; place the digits 1-9 once in every row, column, and 3x3 box.

Loop

• Construct a one-cell-wide loop that only moves orthogonally between cells. Every loop cell is orthogonally adjacent to exactly two other loop cells, and loop cells may not touch diagonally unless a third loop cell joins them. For any two adjacent cells along the loop, the larger digit divided by the smaller gives a whole number.

Arrows

• A cell with an arrow counts the total number of loop cells seen in the arrow's direction, not including itself. A cell with two solid blue arrows is on the loop; a cell with a hollow orange arrow is not on the loop.

Expected Difficulty: 3

Play [Conveyor Belt]

NOTES

Going loopy again. Many thanks to ChinStrap for help with styling, as well as the many testers.
solutionCode: Digits on the loop in column 5, top to bottom.
